title: Point varieties and point-exactness of Koszul algebras
summary: In this paper, we introduce the point-exact condition for a Koszul algebra $A$, which is useful for characterizing the (G1) condition of $A$ in the sense of Mori. Let $B = A/(f)$, where $f \in A_2$ is a regular normal element. We show that if $A$ satisfies the (G1) condition and is point-exact up to degree $\ell \geq 2$, then $B$ also satisfies the (G1) condition and is point-exact up to degree $\ell$. Moreover, we show that skew polynomial algebras satisfy the point-exact condition.
